title: Modul HRD - Evaluation (Penilaian Kinerja) - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap menggunakan Modul Evaluation dalam sistem HRD GIMS mencakup performance evaluation, KPI tracking, feedback, goal setting, dan rating sistem.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Modul Evaluation mengelola proses penilaian kinerja karyawan secara sistematis dan berkelanjutan. Mencakup goal setting, KPI tracking, competency assessment, 360-degree feedback, dan performance rating. Modul ini terintegrasi dengan Employee untuk data karyawan, Payroll untuk adjustment gaji berdasarkan rating, dan HRD Leave untuk reward/punishment decision.

items.title: Goal Setting (MBO)
items.body: Setup tujuan kerja dengan metrik terukur (SMART goals) untuk karyawan per periode

items.title: KPI Tracking
items.body: Monitor Key Performance Indicators real-time dan track progress vs target

items.title: Competency Assessment
items.body: Evaluasi kompetensi hard skills & soft skills dengan rating scale (1-5)

items.title: 360-Degree Feedback
items.body: Kumpulkan feedback dari manager, peer, dan subordinate untuk holistik view

items.title: Performance Review
items.body: Rapat formal antara manager dan employee untuk discuss hasil penilaian

items.title: Rating & Recommendation
items.body: Berikan rating akhir (1-5 scale) dan rekomendasi (promote, maintain, improve, terminate)

items.title: Buka Menu HRD
items.body: Pada sidebar aplikasi, klik menu HRD untuk melihat submenu yang tersedia.

items.title: Pilih Submenu Evaluation
items.body: Dari submenu HRD, klik Evaluation untuk membuka halaman manajemen penilaian kinerja karyawan.

items.title: Goal Setting (Management by Objectives / MBO)
items.body:
Goal Setting adalah proses menetapkan tujuan kerja terukur yang ingin dicapai karyawan dalam periode tertentu (biasanya 1 tahun, atau per semester/quarter).

---

TIUAN GOAL SETTING:

1. Align employee goals dengan company strategy
2. Provide clear direction & measurable target
3. Motivate employee untuk reach potential mereka
4. Facilitate progress tracking & coaching
5. Basis untuk performance evaluation

---

SMART GOALS FRAMEWORK:

Goal harus memenuhi kriteria SMART:

- S (Specific): Jelas & terukur (bukan vague)
  ✗ Bad: "Improve sales"
  ✓ Good: "Increase sales revenue by 20% in Q2 2026"

- M (Measurable): Ada metric/KPI yang bisa diukur
  ✗ Bad: "Improve customer satisfaction"
  ✓ Good: "Achieve NPS score 8.0+ by Q4 2026"

- A (Achievable): Realistically bisa dicapai dengan effort
  ✗ Bad: "Increase revenue 500%" (unrealistic)
  ✓ Good: "Increase revenue 15-25%" (based on historical data)

- R (Relevant): Related to job role dan company goals
  ✗ Bad: "Learn piano" (not job-related)
  ✓ Good: "Complete Java certification" (development role)

- T (Time-bound): Ada deadline jelas
  ✗ Bad: "Improve code quality"
  ✓ Good: "Reduce code bugs 30% by end of Q3 2026"

---

CARA SETUP GOAL (Manager):

1. Buka Evaluation → Goal Setting
2. Klik + Create Goal Period
3. Isi:
   - Period Name: "2026 Annual Goals" atau "Q2 2026 Goals"
   - Start Date: 01/01/2026
   - End Date: 31/12/2026
   - Description: Keterangan tentang goal period
   - Status: DRAFT (editing) → PUBLISHED (active)
4. Klik Save
5. Status: DRAFT (belum final)

---

CARA ASSIGN GOAL KE EMPLOYEE (Manager):

1. Buka Goal Period yang sudah created
2. Klik + Assign Goals
3. Select Employee: Pilih karyawan
4. Isi goal details:
   - Goal Title: "Increase Sales Revenue" (clear & specific)
   - Description: "Generate minimum Rp 500M sales revenue in 2026"
   - Target Metric: Rp 500.000.000
   - Measurement Unit: IDR (Rupiah)
   - Actual Formula: SUM(sales_invoice.total_amount) for year 2026
   - Weight: 40% (importance dalam overall rating)
   - Target Completion: 31/12/2026
   - Success Criteria: 
     - 80-99% target = 3 stars (acceptable)
     - 100-120% target = 4 stars (good)
     - 120%+ target = 5 stars (excellent)
5. Klik Save
6. Repeat untuk goal lain (biasanya 3-5 goals per employee)

---

GOAL TRACKING:

Setelah goal di-assign, system track progress:
1. Manager bisa update actual progress setiap bulan
2. Employee bisa input self-update (optional)
3. System calculate % completion = (Actual / Target) × 100%
4. Dashboard show visual progress (bar chart)
5. Automated alert jika progress lagging

---

EXAMPLE GOALS:

Sales Rep "Ahmad Riyanto" untuk 2026:

1. Goal: Increase Sales Revenue (40% weight)
   - Target: Rp 500M
   - Actual (Jan-Dec): Rp 525M
   - % Completion: 105% → Rating: 4 stars (good)

2. Goal: Customer Acquisition (30% weight)
   - Target: 50 new customers
   - Actual: 48 customers
   - % Completion: 96% → Rating: 3 stars (acceptable)

3. Goal: Customer Retention (20% weight)
   - Target: 95% retention rate
   - Actual: 97%
   - % Completion: 102% → Rating: 5 stars (excellent)

4. Goal: Product Knowledge (10% weight)
   - Target: Complete product certification
   - Actual: Completed
   - % Completion: 100% → Rating: 4 stars (good)

Weighted Score: (4×0.4) + (3×0.3) + (5×0.2) + (4×0.1) = 4.0 stars

---

GOAL REVISION:

Jika kondisi berubah (market crash, strategy shift, dll):
1. Manager bisa request goal revision
2. Submit reason & new target
3. Employee & manager discuss & agree
4. Update goal metrics & target
5. New targets berlaku untuk sisa periode
6. Audit trail recorded (transparency)

items.title: KPI Tracking (Key Performance Indicators)
items.body:
KPI adalah metric spesifik yang di-track real-time untuk monitor performance terhadap goal.

---

BEDA GOAL VS KPI:

GOAL:
- Tujuan akhir (outcome-oriented)
- Setup di awal periode
- Contoh: "Increase revenue Rp 500M"
- Review: End of period (quarterly/annual)

KPI:
- Metric untuk track progress (progress-oriented)
- Monitor kontinyu (daily/weekly/monthly)
- Contoh: "Sales per week: Rp 10M/week"
- Review: Regular (real-time dashboard)

---

JENIS-JENIS KPI:

1. FINANCIAL KPI
   - Revenue/Sales
   - Cost/Expense
   - Profit margin
   - ROI
   - Budget variance

2. OPERATIONAL KPI
   - Productivity (output per hour)
   - Quality (defect rate, error rate)
   - Turnaround time
   - Efficiency (cost per unit)
   - Capacity utilization

3. CUSTOMER KPI
   - Customer satisfaction (NPS, CSAT)
   - Complaint ratio
   - Response time
   - Retention rate
   - Repeat purchase rate

4. PEOPLE KPI
   - Attendance rate
   - On-time delivery
   - Training completion
   - Engagement score
   - Retention rate

---

CARA SETUP KPI (Manager):

1. Buka Evaluation → KPI
2. Klik + Create KPI
3. Isi:
   - KPI Name: "Weekly Sales Revenue"
   - KPI Type: Financial / Operational / Customer / People
   - Measurement: IDR (Rupiah)
   - Frequency: Daily / Weekly / Monthly
   - Target Value: Rp 10.000.000/week
   - Min Value (poor): Rp 5.000.000 (1 star)
   - Target Value (good): Rp 10.000.000 (4 star)
   - Max Value (excellent): Rp 15.000.000+ (5 star)
   - Data Source: Sales system / Manual input
   - Assigned To: Employee
4. Klik Save

---

KPI DASHBOARD:

Employee & Manager bisa lihat KPI dashboard:
1. Trend chart (progress over time)
2. Current value vs target
3. Variance (actual - target)
4. Forecast (apakah akan achieve?)
5. Alerts (if falling behind)

---

EXAMPLE KPI TRACKING:

Sales Rep "Budi Santoso" - Q2 2026:

Week 1: Rp 9M (90% of target) → ✓ On track
Week 2: Rp 8.5M (85% of target) → ⚠ Slight lag
Week 3: Rp 11M (110% of target) → ✓ Good
Week 4: Rp 12M (120% of target) → ✓ Excellent
Week 5: Rp 10M (100% of target) → ✓ On track
Week 6: Rp 9.5M (95% of target) → ✓ On track
Week 7: Rp 13M (130% of target) → ✓ Excellent
Week 8: Rp 11.5M (115% of target) → ✓ Good
Week 9: Rp 10M (100% of target) → ✓ On track
Week 10: Rp 12.5M (125% of target) → ✓ Excellent
Week 11: Rp 11M (110% of target) → ✓ Good
Week 12: Rp 10.5M (105% of target) → ✓ On track
Week 13: Rp 12M (120% of target) → ✓ Excellent

Q2 TOTAL: Rp 130.5M ÷ 13 weeks = Rp 10.04M average (103% of target)
Q2 RATING: 4 stars (GOOD) - Consistent high performance

---

AUTOMATED INSIGHTS:

System dapat generate insights:
- "Sales trending up in week 4 onwards" → Explore root cause
- "Week 2 dip below target" → Discuss with employee
- "Projected Q2 achievement: 102%" → On track
- "Consistency: 10/13 weeks above target" → Reliable performer

items.title: Competency Assessment
items.body:
Competency Assessment adalah evaluasi kemampuan (hard skills & soft skills) karyawan pada berbagai aspek kerja.

---

JENIS COMPETENCIES:

1. TECHNICAL/HARD SKILLS
   - Java Programming
   - Financial Analysis
   - SQL Database
   - Project Management
   - Electrical Engineering

2. SOFT SKILLS
   - Communication
   - Leadership
   - Problem Solving
   - Teamwork
   - Time Management
   - Customer Service

3. BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
   - Integrity
   - Accountability
   - Innovation
   - Adaptability
   - Customer Focus

---

RATING SCALE (1-5):

1 STAR (Novice): Belum menguasai, butuh extensive training & support
2 STARS (Beginner): Menguasai basic, butuh supervision & guidance
3 STARS (Intermediate): Competent, dapat bekerja mandiri, occasional guidance
4 STARS (Advanced): Highly skilled, dapat mentor others, minimal supervision
5 STARS (Expert): Master level, industry standard, strategic contributor

---

CARA SETUP COMPETENCY FRAMEWORK (HR):

1. Buka Evaluation → Competency Framework
2. Klik + Create Framework
3. Isi:
   - Framework Name: "IT Department Competencies 2026"
   - Department: IT / Finance / Sales (or All)
   - Description: Keterangan framework
   - Version: 1.0
4. Add Competencies (click + Add):
   
   Competency 1:
   - Name: "Java Programming"
   - Category: Technical
   - Description: "Ability to write, debug, and optimize Java code"
   - Expected Level: 4 stars (untuk senior dev)
   - Importance: High
   
   Competency 2:
   - Name: "Problem Solving"
   - Category: Behavioral
   - Description: "Ability to analyze problems and find effective solutions"
   - Expected Level: 4 stars
   - Importance: High

5. Klik Save Framework

---

CARA ASSESS COMPETENCY (Manager):

1. Buka Evaluation → Competency Assessment
2. Klik + Create Assessment
3. Isi:
   - Employee: Pilih karyawan
   - Framework: Pilih competency framework
   - Assessment Period: 2026
   - Assessor: Manager name (auto-filled)
4. Rate setiap competency:
   
   Java Programming: 4 stars
   - Evidence: "Delivered 5 modules on time, code quality excellent"
   - Comments: "Strong technical skills, mentor junior devs"
   
   Problem Solving: 4 stars
   - Evidence: "Solved critical production bug in 2 hours"
   - Comments: "Analytical approach, root cause focused"
   
   Communication: 3 stars
   - Evidence: "Clear in team meetings, sometimes unclear in documentation"
   - Comments: "Improvement area: technical writing skills"

5. Klik Submit Assessment
6. Status: SUBMITTED
7. Employee dapat view & provide self-assessment

---

COMPETENCY GAP ANALYSIS:

System dapat identify gaps:

Current Level vs Expected Level:

1. Java Programming
   - Current: 4 stars
   - Expected: 4 stars
   - Gap: NONE ✓ (competent)

2. Problem Solving
   - Current: 4 stars
   - Expected: 4 stars
   - Gap: NONE ✓ (competent)

3. Communication
   - Current: 3 stars
   - Expected: 4 stars
   - Gap: -1 star (needs improvement)
   - Recommendation: Enroll in technical writing course

4. Leadership (for senior role)
   - Current: 2 stars
   - Expected: 4 stars (if promoting to team lead)
   - Gap: -2 stars (significant gap)
   - Recommendation: Not ready for promotion yet. Needs leadership training 6-12 months.

---

DEVELOPMENT PLAN:

Based on gap analysis, create development plan:

1. Identify priority competencies to develop
2. Set development goals (timeline, resource)
3. Assign training/mentoring/project assignment
4. Schedule check-in milestones
5. Re-assess after 6-12 months

Example Development Plan:
- Competency: Communication
- Gap: 3 stars → 4 stars (target 1 year)
- Action: Enroll technical writing course (3 months)
- Practice: Document 2 technical specs (with manager review)
- Mentoring: Pair with senior engineer for code review practices
- Timeline: Complete by Q4 2026
- Re-assess: November 2026

items.title: 360-Degree Feedback
items.body:
360-Degree Feedback adalah feedback yang dikumpulkan dari multiple sources (manager, peers, subordinates, self) untuk memberikan holistik view terhadap performance & behavior karyawan.

---

MULTIPLE PERSPECTIVES:

1. MANAGER VIEW (Top-Down)
   - Evaluasi dari atasan langsung
   - Focus: Job performance, goal achievement, consistency
   - Weight: 40-50%

2. PEER VIEW (Horizontal)
   - Feedback dari rekan kerja (same level)
   - Focus: Collaboration, communication, teamwork, reliability
   - Weight: 20-30%

3. SUBORDINATE VIEW (Bottom-Up)
   - Feedback dari bawahan (if applicable)
   - Focus: Leadership, delegation, support, fairness
   - Weight: 10-15%

4. SELF VIEW (Introspective)
   - Self-assessment dari employee sendiri
   - Focus: Self-awareness, accountability, learning mindset
   - Weight: 10-20%

5. CUSTOMER VIEW (External) - Optional
   - Feedback dari customer/vendor
   - Focus: Service quality, professionalism, problem resolution
   - Weight: 0-10%

---

CARA SETUP 360 FEEDBACK (HR):

1. Buka Evaluation → 360 Feedback
2. Klik + Create 360 Feedback Round
3. Isi:
   - Round Name: "2026 Annual 360 Review"
   - Evaluation Period: Jan-Dec 2026
   - Start Date: 01/11/2026 (biasanya start bulan sebelum review)
   - End Date: 30/11/2026
   - Participant Deadline: 15/11/2026 (saat feedback diharapkan selesai)
4. Define Feedback Questions (template):
   
   Performance:
   - "Employee consistently meets or exceeds goals"
   - "Employee demonstrates strong job knowledge"
   - "Employee produces quality work"
   
   Collaboration:
   - "Employee works effectively with team members"
   - "Employee communicates clearly"
   - "Employee shares knowledge generously"
   
   Leadership (if manager):
   - "Employee provides clear direction to team"
   - "Employee develops talents of team members"
   - "Employee makes fair decisions"
   
   Personal:
   - "Employee is reliable and accountable"
   - "Employee demonstrates integrity"
   - "Employee is open to feedback and learning"

5. Set Scale: 1-5 scale dengan descriptors
6. Klik Publish
7. Status: PUBLISHED (ready for feedback collection)

---

CARA SUBMIT 360 FEEDBACK (Rater):

1. HR sends invitation to all raters (manager, peers, subordinates)
2. Rater menerima email: "360 feedback request for [Employee Name]"
3. Rater klik link & login
4. Rate employee untuk setiap question (1-5 scale)
5. Provide open-ended comments:
   - "Strengths: [what they do well]"
   - "Areas to improve: [development areas]"
   - "Overall feedback: [constructive comments]"
6. Klik Submit
7. Feedback anonymous (rater name tidak ditampilkan ke employee)

---

CARA VIEW 360 RESULTS (Employee & Manager):

1. Setelah deadline, HR close feedback collection
2. System aggregate results:
   
   Question 1: "Employee consistently meets or exceeds goals"
   - Manager: 5 stars
   - Peer 1: 4 stars
   - Peer 2: 4 stars
   - Subordinate 1: 5 stars
   - Average: 4.5 stars ✓ (STRONG)
   
   Question 2: "Employee demonstrates strong job knowledge"
   - Manager: 4 stars
   - Peer 1: 4 stars
   - Peer 2: 3 stars
   - Subordinate 1: 4 stars
   - Average: 3.75 stars ✓ (GOOD)
   
   Question 3: "Employee works effectively with team members"
   - Manager: 3 stars
   - Peer 1: 3 stars
   - Peer 2: 2 stars
   - Subordinate 1: 3 stars
   - Average: 2.75 stars ⚠ (NEEDS IMPROVEMENT)

3. Anonymous Comments:
   - "Great technical skills, sometimes difficult in meetings"
   - "Good team player, very helpful"
   - "Could improve communication with non-technical team"

4. Manager & Employee see aggregate results (anonymous, no individual names)
5. Focus: Patterns & insights, not individual rater identification

---

360 INTERPRETATION:

High consistency (all raters similar score) = Consensus
High variance (very different scores) = Perception gap (need discussion)

Example:
- Manager rates 5, all others rate 3 = Manager might be biased (too lenient)
- Manager rates 2, all others rate 4 = Manager too critical
- Wide spread (1,3,4,5) = Inconsistent behavior (context-dependent?)

---

USE 360 RESULTS:

1. Self-awareness: Employee see how others perceive them
2. Development planning: Identify strengths & growth areas
3. Promotion decision: 360 360 input untuk assess readiness
4. Retention: High scores improve satisfaction & commitment
5. Bias reduction: Multiple perspectives reduce manager bias

items.title: Performance Review Meeting
items.body:
Performance Review Meeting adalah pertemuan formal antara manager dan employee untuk discuss evaluation results dan career development.

---

OBJEKTIF PERFORMANCE REVIEW:

1. DISCUSS RESULTS
   - Review goal achievement
   - Discuss KPI performance
   - Explain rating & feedback
   - Celebrate wins, discuss challenges

2. PROVIDE FEEDBACK
   - Share 360-degree feedback insights
   - Highlight strengths
   - Identify improvement areas
   - Give constructive suggestions

3. CAREER DEVELOPMENT
   - Discuss career aspirations
   - Plan skill development
   - Identify learning opportunities
   - Explore promotion/lateral move

4. SET EXPECTATIONS
   - Clarify role & responsibilities
   - Align next period goals
   - Discuss company direction
   - Address any concerns

---

CARA SCHEDULE REVIEW MEETING (Manager):

1. Buka Evaluation → Performance Reviews
2. Klik + Schedule Review Meeting
3. Isi:
   - Employee: Pilih karyawan
   - Evaluation Period: 2026
   - Meeting Date: 15/01/2027 (after evaluation complete)
   - Meeting Time: 10:00-11:00
   - Location: Meeting room / Virtual (Zoom)
   - Prepared By: Manager
4. Attach documents:
   - Goal summary (achievement % untuk semua goals)
   - KPI dashboard (trend & final numbers)
   - 360 feedback results (anonymous summary)
   - Competency assessment
   - Self-assessment dari employee (jika sudah submit)
5. Klik Send Invitation
6. Employee menerima calendar invite
7. Status: SCHEDULED

---

PREPARATION CHECKLIST (Manager):

Before meeting:
✓ Review semua evaluation data (goals, KPI, 360, competency)
✓ Prepare talking points & examples (specific, factual)
✓ Rate overall performance (1-5 scale)
✓ Write summary comments
✓ Identify strengths to praise
✓ Identify development areas to discuss
✓ Prepare compensation recommendation (if applicable)
✓ Schedule follow-up sessions (if needed)
✓ Prepare career discussion points

---

MEETING STRUCTURE (60 minutes):

Phase 1: Opening (5 min)
- Welcome & set tone (informal, constructive)
- Outline agenda
- Example: "Thanks for meeting. Today we'll review 2026 performance, discuss feedback, and talk about 2027 goals."

Phase 2: Employee Self-Assessment (10 min)
- Ask employee: "How do you think you performed this year?"
- Listen to employee perspective
- Acknowledge their view
- Example: "I see you feel good about sales growth. Let's look at the numbers."

Phase 3: Review Results (20 min)
- Discuss each goal:
  - "Goal 1: Increase revenue Rp 500M. Actual: Rp 525M (105%). Great job!"
  - "Goal 2: Customer retention 95%. Actual: 97%. Exceeded!"
  - "Goal 3: Product certification. Completed. Well done!"
  - "Goal 4: Team mentoring. Mentored 2 junior devs. Strong contribution!"

- Discuss KPI trend:
  - "Looking at weekly sales, you were consistent in Q1-Q2, slight dip Q3, strong comeback Q4. Good recovery."
  - "Average 102% of target. Reliable performer."

- Discuss 360 feedback:
  - "Feedback dari manager, peers, subordinate consistent: strong technical skills, great collaboration."
  - "One area mentioned: can improve communication in large group settings. Have you noticed that?"
  - "Not a blocker, but something to develop for future leadership role."

Phase 4: Overall Rating (5 min)
- Give final rating: "Based on all factors, I'm rating you 4 stars for 2026."
- Explain rating:
  - "You exceeded goals, strong KPI performance, good feedback from team."
  - "4 stars (Advanced) means you're reliable performer, consistently deliver, can mentor others."
  - "Path to 5 stars: further develop communication in large groups, take on more strategic projects."

Phase 5: Feedback & Development (15 min)
- Discuss strengths:
  - "Your technical expertise is exceptional. That's your biggest value."
  - "Your reliability is appreciated by team. You're someone people can count on."
  - "Great problem solver. The way you handled the production issue was impressive."

- Discuss development areas:
  - "One area to develop: presentation skills. For future leadership, you'll need to present to executives."
  - "Recommendation: Enroll in presentation course in Q1 2027."
  - "Also, consider mentoring 1-2 junior devs. Will help develop leadership."

Phase 6: Career Discussion (10 min)
- Ask: "Where do you see yourself in 2-3 years?"
- Discuss aspirations:
  - "You mentioned interest in tech lead role. That's achievable. Here's development plan:"
  - "Q1-Q2: Deep-dive architecture design"
  - "Q2-Q3: Lead small project end-to-end"
  - "Q4: Formal tech lead assessment & possible promotion"
- Discuss opportunities:
  - "You could be ready for promotion in 12-18 months."
  - "Let's plan the development path together."

Phase 7: Closing (5 min)
- Summarize:
  - "So, to recap: You had a great 2026. 4-star rating, goals exceeded, positive feedback."
  - "For 2027: Focus on presentation skills & architecture knowledge. We'll support with training."
  - "Let's schedule quarterly check-ins to track progress."
- Next steps:
  - "I'll update the system with review results today."
  - "Let's meet again end of Q1 to discuss 2027 goals."
  - "Any questions or concerns?"

---

FOLLOW-UP AFTER REVIEW:

1. Manager update system: Rating, comments, development plan
2. HR notified: Review completed, send to Finance (for compensation)
3. System generate performance review report
4. Employee can provide feedback on review meeting (optional)
5. Schedule quarterly check-in meetings (Q1, Q2, Q3)
6. Track development plan progress
7. Prepare for next review cycle

items.title: Rating & Promotion/Development Recommendation
items.body:
Rating adalah penilaian akhir performance karyawan dalam periode tertentu, dan dijadikan basis untuk keputusan kompensasi, promosi, atau pengembangan.

---

PERFORMANCE RATING SCALE (1-5):

1 STAR (Poor Performance)
- Below expectations, significant performance issues
- Goals: <50% achievement
- KPI: Consistently below target
- Feedback: Negative (multiple areas concern)
- Action: Performance improvement plan (PIP), potential termination
- Salary: No increase, possible cut

2 STARS (Below Average)
- Below expectations but showing some effort
- Goals: 50-70% achievement
- KPI: Mostly below target
- Feedback: Mixed (some strengths, multiple concerns)
- Action: Development plan, improve atau move
- Salary: No increase or minimal increase

3 STARS (Meets Expectations)
- Meets job requirements, acceptable performance
- Goals: 80-100% achievement
- KPI: Mostly on target
- Feedback: Positive (competent performer)
- Action: Continue role, optional development
- Salary: Standard increase (e.g., 3-5%)

4 STARS (Exceeds Expectations)
- Strong performer, delivers beyond requirements
- Goals: 100-120% achievement
- KPI: Consistently above target
- Feedback: Very positive (valuable contributor)
- Action: Consider promotion, stretch assignment
- Salary: Above-average increase (e.g., 7-10%)

5 STARS (Far Exceeds Expectations)
- Top performer, exceptional contributions
- Goals: 120%+ achievement
- KPI: Consistently far above target
- Feedback: Excellent (strategic contributor, high potential)
- Action: Fast-track development, succession planning
- Salary: Premium increase (e.g., 12-15%) + bonus

---

CARA GENERATE RATING (Manager):

1. Buka Evaluation → Performance Rating
2. Klik + Create Rating
3. Isi:
   - Employee: Pilih karyawan
   - Evaluation Period: 2026
   - Rating Score: 1-5 stars (based on all factors)
   - Rating Category: Poor / Below Average / Meets / Exceeds / Far Exceeds
   
   Calculation (example):
   - Goal Achievement: 105% → 4 stars (weight 40%)
   - KPI Performance: 103% → 4 stars (weight 30%)
   - Competency: Average 3.8 → 4 stars (weight 20%)
   - 360 Feedback: Average 4.2 → 4 stars (weight 10%)
   - Final Rating: (4×0.4) + (4×0.3) + (4×0.2) + (4×0.1) = 4.0 stars

4. Write summary comments (500 words):
   "Ahmad demonstrated strong performance in 2026. Exceeded sales goals with Rp 525M revenue (105% vs target Rp 500M). KPI consistent: weekly average Rp 10.04M (103% of Rp 9.8M target). Feedback positive from manager, peers, team members. Strengths: sales acumen, customer relationship, reliability. Development area: presentation skills (working on). Overall: 4-star (Advanced) performer. Valuable contributor to team."

5. Klik Save & Submit
6. Status: SUBMITTED (awaiting HR approval)

---

RECOMMENDATION:

Based on rating, manager provide recommendation:

1. SALARY ADJUSTMENT
   - 1 star: No increase / Possible cut (0%)
   - 2 star: Minimal increase (1-2%)
   - 3 star: Standard increase (3-5%)
   - 4 star: Above-average increase (7-10%)
   - 5 star: Premium increase (12-15%) + bonus
   
   Example: Ahmad 4-star → Recommend 8% salary increase
   Current salary: Rp 10.000.000/month
   Recommended: Rp 10.800.000/month (Rp 800.000 increase)

2. PROMOTION
   - 1-2 star: Not eligible
   - 3 star: Eligible if aspire (with development)
   - 4 star: Strong candidate, ready for stretch role
   - 5 star: Fast-track, succession planning candidate
   
   Example: Ahmad 4-star → Eligible for promotion to Senior Sales Executive
   Timeline: Ready in 12 months (after development plan)
   Preparation: Mentoring, strategic account assignment

3. DEVELOPMENT PLAN
   - All stars: Individualized development plan
   - 1-2 star: Urgent improvement plan (6-month intensive)
   - 3 star: Skill enhancement (optional)
   - 4-5 star: Leadership/strategic development
   
   Example: Ahmad 4-star → Development plan for tech lead role
   Focus: Presentation skills, architecture knowledge
   Timeline: 12-18 months
   Support: External training, mentoring, project assignment

4. LATERAL MOVE (if applicable)
   - Employee strong in current role, but better fit elsewhere
   - Example: "Ahmad excellent in inside sales. Maybe fit for account management?"
   - Discuss with employee

5. TERMINATION (1-2 star only)
   - Last resort (after PIP unsuccessful)
   - Severance package, reference letter
   - Documentation required (compliance)

---

HR APPROVAL & PROCESSING:

1. HR review manager ratings (consistency check)
   - Are ratings justified by data?
   - Any outliers (too high/low)?
   - Comparable to peers? (equity check)

2. Finance calculate impact:
   - Total salary increases
   - Bonus budgets
   - Promotion adjustments
   - Head count changes (terminations)

3. Approve & finalize ratings
4. Communicate decisions to employees
5. Process compensation changes (payroll)
6. Archive evaluation records (compliance)

items.title: Skenario 1: Complete Evaluation Cycle (Annual)
items.body:
Karyawan "Siti Nurhaliza" (Senior Developer) menjalani evaluasi tahunan 2026.

TIMELINE:

January 2026 - Goal Setting:
1. Manager "Andi Wijaya" meet dengan Siti
2. Discuss 2026 goals:
   Goal 1: Complete mobile app project (40% weight)
   Goal 2: Mentor 2 junior developers (30% weight)
   Goal 3: Reduce code defects 20% (20% weight)
   Goal 4: Improve team documentation (10% weight)
3. Siti agree & sign off
4. Goals published in system

January-December 2026 - KPI Tracking:
1. System track KPIs monthly:
   - Code defect rate (target: <2%)
   - Completed features (target: 15/year)
   - Documentation pages (target: 10/year)
   - Mentoring hours (target: 4h/month)
2. Manager & Siti review monthly (15 min check-in)
3. System alert jika ada lag dari target
4. End-year aggregate: KPI achievement 95%

September-October 2026 - Competency Assessment:
1. Manager assess Siti competencies:
   - Java/Spring Boot: 5 stars (Expert)
   - System Design: 4 stars (Advanced)
   - Mentoring: 4 stars (Advanced)
   - Communication: 3 stars (Intermediate) ← Gap area
   - Leadership: 3 stars (Intermediate) ← Development opportunity

2. System identify gaps:
   - Current communication: 3 stars vs expected 4 stars → Gap -1
   - Recommend: Presentation skills training

October 2026 - 360 Feedback:
1. HR setup 360 feedback round
2. Raters: Andi (manager), 3 peers, 2 subordinates
3. Questions:
   - "Siti demonstrates strong technical skills"
   - "Siti communicates clearly in meetings"
   - "Siti mentors junior developers effectively"
   - "Siti shows leadership potential"
4. Results aggregate:
   - Technical skills: 4.8/5 (very high)
   - Clear communication: 2.8/5 (needs improvement) ← Concern
   - Mentoring: 4.5/5 (excellent)
   - Leadership: 3.5/5 (moderate)
5. Comments:
   - "Great technical skills, sometimes hard to follow in large meetings"
   - "Very supportive mentor, juniors love working with her"
   - "Could improve documentation of technical decisions"

November 2026 - Performance Review Meeting:
1. Schedule: 15/11/2026, 10:00-11:00, Meeting room
2. Manager prepare all documents
3. Meeting flow:
   - Opening: "Thanks for great contribution 2026. Let's discuss your performance."
   - Goals review:
     - Goal 1 (Mobile app): 95% complete (project extended to Jan 2027) → 3 stars
     - Goal 2 (Mentoring): Mentored 2 juniors, 48 hours/year → 4 stars
     - Goal 3 (Code defects): Reduced from 5% to 2.5% → 4 stars
     - Goal 4 (Documentation): Created 8 docs (target 10) → 3 stars
     - Weighted score: (3×0.4) + (4×0.3) + (4×0.2) + (3×0.1) = 3.5
   
   - KPI review: "Consistent monthly, averaged 95% achievement. Good."
   
   - 360 feedback: "Technical skills exceptional. Communication area to develop."
   
   - Strengths: "Your technical expertise is invaluable. Mentoring is excellent contribution."
   
   - Development area: "Communication in large settings. Let's work on presentation skills."
   
   - Career discussion: "You have potential for technical lead. Let's plan next 12 months."
   
   - Overall rating: 3.5 ≈ 4 STARS (Advanced) "Based on all factors, you're 4-star performer."
   
   - Recommendation: "Recommend 8% salary increase + enrollment in presentation course + assign tech lead role in Q2 2027."

4. Siti feedback: "I appreciate the feedback. Will focus on communication. Excited about tech lead opportunity."

December 2026 - Finalization:
1. Manager submit rating in system
2. HR approve & process
3. Finance calculate salary adjustment:
   - Current: Rp 15.000.000/month
   - New: Rp 15.000.000 × 1.08 = Rp 16.200.000/month
   - Effective: 01/01/2027

4. Notify Siti: Rating approved, salary adjusted, training enrollment
5. Archive evaluation records

RESULT:
- Siti rated 4 stars (Advanced)
- Salary increased 8% (Rp 1.200.000/month)
- Development plan: Presentation skills + tech lead pathway
- Next review: 2027 annual evaluation

items.title: Skenario 2: Below-Average Performance & PIP
items.body:
Karyawan "Ahmad Riyanto" (Sales Rep) performing below expectations. Manager implement Performance Improvement Plan.

TIMELINE:

January 2026 - Goals Set:
1. Goal: Achieve Rp 500M sales revenue
2. KPI: Weekly average Rp 9.6M
3. Target: 4-star performance

Mid-Year Review (June 2026):
1. Q1-Q2 actual: Rp 180M (only 72% vs target Rp 250M)
2. KPI: Weekly average Rp 6.9M (72% of target)
3. Manager meet Ahmad:
   - "Sales below target. What's happening?"
   - Ahmad: "Market slow. Clients delaying decisions."
   - Manager: "I understand. But we need improvement. Let's make a plan."
4. Informal plan (no formal PIP yet):
   - Manager coaching: Weekly 1-on-1
   - More account assignment
   - Peer mentoring from top performer
   - 60-day review (end August)

August 2026 - No Improvement:
1. Q3 actual: Rp 200M (still only 67% vs 333M expected by Q3)
2. KPI: Rp 6.5M/week (68% of target)
3. Manager assess: "No improvement despite support."
4. Formal discussion:
   - "Ahmad, we've given coaching & support. Performance still not meeting target."
   - "We need to escalate to formal PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)."
   - "Here's 90-day formal plan to get back on track."

October 2026 - Formal PIP (Performance Improvement Plan):

PIP Terms:
- Duration: 90 days (01/10 - 31/12/2026)
- Expectations:
  - Weekly sales target: Rp 9.6M (minimum)
  - Monthly review meetings
  - New client acquisition: 5 clients/month
  - Follow sales process (100% compliance)
  - Attend sales training course

- Support provided:
  - Weekly coaching from manager
  - Pairing with top performer "Budi Santoso"
  - Sales techniques training (external course)
  - Additional accounts assignment
  - Resources: Marketing support, tools, leads

- Success criteria:
  - Achieve Rp 9.6M/week average in Oct-Dec
  - If success: Continue employment, back to normal review cycle
  - If fail: Termination (last resort, after 90 days)

- Review schedule:
  - Oct 31: Mid-point review (30 days)
  - Dec 15: Final review (90 days)

October - PIP Monitoring:
1. Week 1-2: Rp 8.5M (good, improvement)
2. Week 3-4: Rp 9.0M (on track)
3. Month-end: Average Rp 8.75M (87% of target, trending up)
4. Manager: "Good progress. Keep momentum."
5. Ahmad: "Learning from Budi. Sales techniques helping."

November - Continued Improvement:
1. Week 1-2: Rp 9.5M (almost there!)
2. Week 3-4: Rp 10.0M (exceeding target!)
3. Month-end: Average Rp 9.75M (101% of target!)
4. Manager: "Excellent. You're on track."
5. Ahmad building confidence

December - Final Stretch:
1. Week 1: Rp 9.2M
2. Week 2: Rp 10.5M
3. Week 3: Rp 9.8M
4. Week 4 (final): Rp 10.2M
5. Month-end: Average Rp 9.93M (103% of target)

December 31 - Final PIP Review:
1. Manager & Ahmad meet
2. Results review:
   - Oct: 87% of target (mid-point was concerning)
   - Nov: 101% of target (turned around!)
   - Dec: 103% of target (strong finish)
   - 90-day average: 97% of target (PASS, just under but acceptable)
3. Manager decision: "Ahmad, you've shown improvement. PIP successful."
4. Ahmad: "I'm relieved. I was struggling but the support helped."
5. Going forward:
   - Continue at Rp 9.6M/week minimum
   - Monthly check-ins (instead of weekly)
   - Remove PIP status
   - Back to normal evaluation cycle
   - 2027: Fresh start, opportunity to earn 3+ stars

2027 Evaluation:
1. Q1-Q4 2027 perform at Rp 9.8M/week average (103% of target)
2. Manager rate: 3 stars (Meets Expectations)
3. Salary: Standard increase 3%
4. Note: "Improved after PIP. Reliable performer now."
5. Ahmad rebuild reputation & career

KEY LEARNINGS:
- Manager gave support (coaching, mentoring, training)
- Ahmad took ownership (willingness to improve)
- PIP structured but not punitive (goal is improvement, not punishment)
- Clear expectations & timeline
- Regular feedback & monitoring
- Success = back to normal employment
- Failure = termination (last resort)

items.title: Pertanyaan Umum
items.body:
Q: Bagaimana jika karyawan tidak setuju dengan rating?
A: Employee bisa appeal & discuss dengan manager. System record persetujuan/ketidaksetujuan. HR dapat mediate jika ada significant disagreement. Evaluasi adalah subjective, diskusi penting untuk clarity.

Q: Apakah 360 feedback aman (anonymous)?
A: Ya, semua feedback anonymous (rater names tidak ditampilkan). System hanya aggregate & summary yang terlihat ke employee. Rater confidentiality protected.

Q: Bagaimana jika manager rating terlalu tinggi/rendah dibanding peers?
A: HR review consistency & compare dengan peers (calibration). Jika ada outlier, HR diskusi dengan manager untuk ensure fairness & equity. Normalization jika perlu.

Q: Bisakah goal di-change di tengah tahun?
A: Ya, goal dapat di-revise jika situasi berubah significantly (market change, strategy shift, dll). Perlu approval dari manager & documented. Old goals archived untuk audit trail.

Q: Apakah 4-star rating selalu berarti promosi?
A: Tidak otomatis. 4-star = qualified untuk promosi, tapi bukan guaranteed. Ada factors lain: role availability, readiness, development plan completion, etc. Discuss dengan manager untuk career path.

Q: Bagaimana dengan karyawan kontrak atau baru join?
A: Kontrak: Evaluasi sesuai durasi (jika 6-bulan, review 6-bulanan). Baru join: Biasanya skip first 6 bulan (learning phase), evaluasi mulai bulan ke-6 atau year 1. Disesuaikan kebijakan company.

Q: Apakah rating mempengaruhi severance jika di-terminate?
A: Yes, rating dapat mempengaruhi severance package. Misal: 3-4 star = standard severance, 1-2 star (PIP failed) = minimal severance, 5 star = generous severance. Documented dalam policy.

items.title: Best Practices
items.body:
1. Goal harus SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound)
   - Jangan vague, pastikan bisa diukur
   - Align dengan company strategy
   - Review & adjust jika kondisi berubah

2. KPI harus real-time trackable
   - Setup automated data collection (jangan manual)
   - Dashboard accessible untuk employee & manager
   - Regular monitoring (weekly/monthly)

3. 360 Feedback harus anonymous & psychologically safe
   - Protect rater confidentiality
   - Frame constructively (development, bukan penalty)
   - Aggregate results (tidak individual rater)
   - Follow-up dengan coaching

4. Review Meeting harus two-way conversation
   - Jangan monolog (manager criticize)
   - Listen ke employee perspective
   - Collaborative problem-solving
   - Document agreed action items

5. Rating harus consistent & fair
   - Use calibration session (compare across team)
   - Check for bias (gender, seniority, personal preference)
   - Use rubric/guideline (ensure consistency)
   - Document justification

6. Evaluation bukan punishment tool
   - Focus development, bukan blame
   - Provide support & resources
   - PIP = last resort (after coaching failed)
   - Success-oriented mindset

7. Follow privacy & compliance
   - Store evaluation data secure
   - Access controlled (manager, HR, employee)
   - Retention policy (usually 3+ years untuk compliance)
   - Audit trail recorded (who accessed when)

8. Regular communication
   - Don't surprise employee di review meeting
   - Monthly check-in (not just annual review)
   - Address issues early
   - Celebrate wins & progress

content.body:
Modul Evaluation terintegrasi dengan beberapa modul lain:

1. Integrasi dengan Employee
Data employee (role, department, join date) dari Employee module digunakan untuk menentukan evaluation cycle & competency framework. Goal assignment memerlukan employee data yang valid.

2. Integrasi dengan Payroll
Performance rating dari Evaluation module mempengaruhi compensation decision. Salary adjustment, bonus, incentive didasarkan pada rating & manager recommendation. Finance import data ke payroll system.

3. Integrasi dengan Leave Request
Performance review dapat mempengaruhi leave approval (context). Misal: employee dengan rating 1 (PIP) mungkin restrictions untuk leave (focus improvement). Sebaliknya, 5-star dapat flexible leave.

4. Integrasi dengan Organizational Structure
Competency framework & goal template dapat di-setup per department/role. Evaluation cycle consistency maintained across organizational hierarchy.

5. Integrasi dengan Learning & Development
Competency gap & development plan terintegrasi dengan L&D module. Training enrollment, mentoring assignment, certification tracking linked ke evaluation results.
